tools_helpful.evidence: session-log.txt: scaffold + package restore + clean build (metrics.builds=true, code_changes +359 -212)

tool_limitations.limitation: Section 5 manifest checks flag TargetDeviceFamily, rescap namespace, runFullTrust, and windows.backgroundTasks extensions, but do NOT flag uap4:CustomCapability / SCCD-gated restricted capabilities, which also break package registration for a sideloaded WinUI 3 app.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add a 5d check that fails when the manifest declares uap4:CustomCapability (or other SCCD-gated capabilities) and tells the agent to remove it.

doc_errors.wrong: 'Keep any UWP <Capability> entries you actually use' — unconditional, with no exception for custom/restricted SCCD-gated capabilities.
doc_errors.correct: Keep ordinary capabilities, but strip uap4:CustomCapability and other capabilities that require a signed custom capability descriptor (SCCD); a sideloaded WinUI 3 package has no SCCD and registration of the windows.capability extension fails with 0x80073CF6 / inner 0x80070002.

special_apis.special_handling: Requires an SCCD provisioned on the machine. Not available for a sideloaded WinUI 3 migration target, so it must be removed from Package.appxmanifest or the app cannot be registered/launched.

errors_encountered.error: Package registration failed: error 0x80073CF6 / inner 0x80070002 registering the windows.capability extension (both 'dotnet run' and 'winapp run').
errors_encountered.root_cause: Package.appxmanifest retained the UWP sample's uap4:CustomCapability Name='Microsoft.onDemandHotspotControl_8wekyb3d8bbwe', which requires a signed custom capability descriptor (SCCD) that is absent for the sideloaded WinUI 3 package.
errors_encountered.fix: Remove the uap4:CustomCapability element (and any SCCD-gated restricted capability) from the migrated manifest; the build stays clean and every foreground scenario becomes reachable.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: App builds cleanly but never launches; score 0. The manifest kept uap4:CustomCapability.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: not retried — the agent never ran the app (migration agent does not launch), so the failure was invisible during the trial; results.json runs=false.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The manifest checklist told the agent to add runFullTrust and reconcile background-task extensions, but said nothing about SCCD-gated custom/restricted capabilities, and item 3 explicitly said to keep capabilities the app uses — so the agent copied uap4:CustomCapability verbatim.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 check (5d) that flags uap4:CustomCapability / SCCD-gated capabilities, plus a checklist item in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md and SKILL.md directing removal.

missing_tooling.need: Manifest validation for SCCD-gated custom/restricted capabilities.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The entire score — the sole blocker was an unremoved uap4:CustomCapability that a manifest check would have caught before launch.
